title: Apple TV's 'Carême' Wins International Emmy for Best Drama
content:
Apple TV's French-language drama "Carême" won the Drama Series award at the 54th International Emmy Awards earlier this week, marking Apple's second win in the category following "Drops of God" in 2024. The series follows a chef whose culinary ambitions draw him into espionage in Napoleon's France. The first season is available to stream on Apple TV. A second season is currently in production.
